messages:
sophie (CS): FYI card: CardioCloud (acct: cardicloud-prod) opened a ticket — they completed SSO onboarding but they can't find an API key in their console and calls return "401: missing_api_key". customer says they clicked 'Create API key' in the UI but nothing shows. can someone take a look?

devon (Onboard Eng): copying details — can you paste the user email and the exact project name they selected? also which browser/region?

sophie (CS): email is claire@cardiocloud.io, project name they picked during flow was "cardiocloud-prod". browser chrome latest, region us-west-2. ticket id #7893.

onboard-bot: ProvisionerEvent: created key=key_abc123, client_id=cli_9f7a, project_hint=cardiocloud-prod, status=created, attached_project=null

maria (Support): interesting — bot shows attached_project=null which indicates the key was created but never linked. i've seen this before with a provisioning race when a duplicate client_id is present. can you check the provisioner logs for that client_id?

devon (Onboard Eng): running quick query against provisioner logs for client_id=cli_9f7a. found this:

```
2025-08-16T14:22:11Z INFO Incoming SSO claim for user claire@cardiocloud.io, session=ses_44
2025-08-16T14:22:12Z INFO creating api-key placeholder client_id=cli_9f7a
2025-08-16T14:22:12Z ERROR project-attach failed: duplicate_client_id detected; abort attach
2025-08-16T14:22:12Z INFO created key key_abc123 but project.attach=NULL
```

So the create step succeeded but attach failed due to a duplicate client_id check returning true (we treat it as fatal). looks like the id was recycled from a failed earlier run.

aj (Backend Eng): ok that's a bug in the id-generation uniqueness check + attach transactional flow. short-term fix: we can attach the key to the correct project manually. long-term we need a retry/cleanup in the provisioner.

maria (Support): devon, can you confirm whether the key exists in the admin keys table and whether it has any scopes? if it's attached with null project, the console filters it out.

devon (Onboard Eng): running admin API check: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" https://internal-api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/keys/key_abc123` returned:

```
{
  "id": "key_abc123",
  "client_id": "cli_9f7a",
  "project": null,
  "scopes": ["inference:generate"],
  "created_at": "2025-08-16T14:22:12Z"
}
```

Yep project is null, scopes look fine. That explains why the console and normal API calls return 401 for the customer (no project mapping -> requests treated as unknown key).

aj (Backend Eng): I'll attach it now. doing an authorized backend call to reassign: `POST /v1/internal/admin/keys/key_abc123/attach {"project":"cardiocloud-prod"}`. patching the linkage and emitting audit.

aj (Backend Eng): done — response 200. audit log id audit_5572 created.

onboard-bot: ProvisionerEvent: attach_completed key=key_abc123 project=cardiocloud-prod actor=aj

maria (Support): can someone confirm the customer can see it in console? sophie, you can tell Claire to refresh and log out/in. sometimes the UI cache hides newly attached keys for a few seconds.

sophie (CS): messaged customer: "Claire — we found your API key, it was created but not linked to your project due to a provisioning race. We've attached it to cardicloud-prod and you should see it after you refresh or logout/login. Please let us know if you still can't see it."

claire@cardiocloud.io (via ticket update): I see the key now, thanks! tried a quick call `curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <the-key>'` and got a 200.

maria (Support): :thumbsup: marking this as resolved in ticket #7893. created follow-up GH issue infra/provisioner#472 for duplicate client_id handling and transactional attach retry. devon/aj — can you add a short postmortem note in eng-oncall? we'll want an action item for a cleanup job that finds keys with project=null older than 5m and retries attach.

devon (Onboard Eng): noted, will add to eng-oncall and schedule a one-time repair job. thanks all.

aj (Backend Eng): PR submitted to provisioner to make attach idempotent and to regenerate client_id if duplicate detected. ref: https://github.com/redwood-inference/provisioner/pull/128 :rocket: 

sophie (CS): closing loop with customer and updating internal ticket. thanks team!
